narrative.overview: User-directed preservation of the established paper, ink-green and cinnabar identity with a dialogue stage.
keyCharacteristics: One natural beat at a time

rules.name: Scene authorship
rules.body: Ink and the presentation manifest drive new scenes without UI story conditionals.

dos: Keep the established palette and local font fallbacks.
Use genuine generated art with provenance.
donts: Do not append the whole novel to the main stage.
Do not bake choices into images.
